name: sector_e_level_1
description: Start the player in sector E level 1 instead of the default starting room.
evidence: $0BC8 is the game start initialiser: it writes $01 to the primary reference at $90 and $00 to the secondary reference at $8F before the first room is drawn
$90 is the horizontal room index: enter_room_to_the_right increments it through the $1211 vector and enter_room_to_the_left decrements it through $120C
$8F is the vertical room index: enter_room_above decrements it through the $1203 vector, so $8F counts downwards from the top and $00 is the topmost level
the title program states that sector A is at the extreme left and sector H at the extreme right, so the sector letter is a linear function of $90
qualifications: the mapping from $90 to a sector letter is not proved from the bytes; start_sector is determined by reading the location sign the game draws
$0BC8 has no runtime evidence in any committed trace because it runs before every traced window begins
